name: 楊元森
objective: The primary purpose of this course is to present methods for analyzing the stresses and deflections developed in any given type of structure whenit is subjected to an arbitary dynamic loading.
schedule:
W1: Introduction
W2: Free vibration analysis  (class time to move to week 3 or 4, to be scheduled in week 1) 

W3: Response to harmonic loading
W4: Response to periodic loading
W5: Response to impulsive loading
W6: Response to arbitrary loading - Duhamel integral
W7: Response to arbitrary loading - step-by-step integration method
W8: Midterm
W9: Response spectra
W10: Application of response spectra
W11: Generalized single degree of freedom system
W12: Equations of motion for MDOF system
W13: Formulations of structural matrices for MDOF system
W14: Free vibration analysis for MDOF system
W15: Modal superposition method
W16: Final exam
W17: Advanced topic 1 (online)
W18: Advanced topic 2 (online)
scorePolicy:
1. Attendance, quiz, homework (35%) (including w17/18 quiz) 
2. Midterm (30%)
3. Final exam (35%)
materials: Dynamics of Structures: Theory and Applications to Earthquake Engineering 5/e CHOPRA (ISBN 9781292249186)
consultation: Will be announced in the first-week lecture.
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
remarks: The lecture is regularly video recorded and is available at the NTUT iStudy (北科 i 學園). In case that the lecture has to be carried out online, it will be at Google Meet:  https://meet.google.com/yiu-jwqa-ckm
